# ARMSE benchmark report (generated by `python3 -m armse.bench`)

Model/simulator results only - no synthesis, no RTL simulation, no board. Hardware model: lanes=8, bus=4 B/cycle, row_lat=12, A/B buffers 2048 B each, O buffer 4096 B, total on-chip 8192 B. Fixed square tile: single=32, double=16.

## 1. Correctness

144 (workload, policy) runs were executed functionally and compared bit-exactly with an independent int64 numpy reference: 0 mismatches. All 180 runs passed the deadlock and buffer-hazard checks.

**Where adaptive scheduling does not help.** D_adaptive is slower than C_best_square on 4 workloads (wide_16x512x64, deepK_32x32x1024, mlp_b1_L2, mlp_b32_L1); D_feedback on 1 (wide_16x512x64). Workloads whose runtime is compute-bound leave nothing for memory scheduling to win (see section 4).

## 3. Cost-model calibration (estimator vs event simulator)

Traffic bytes, DMA-busy and compute-busy cycles are exact closed forms (asserted in tests over 600 random cases). Total-cycle prediction is approximate:

| policy | mean_abs_err_pct | max_abs_err_pct | bias_pct | bytes_exact |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A_direct | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | True |
| B_fixed_single | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | True |
| C_best_square | 0.762 | 9.010 | -0.762 | True |
| C_fixed_double | 1.018 | 7.627 | -1.018 | True |
| D_adaptive | 5.129 | 14.606 | -5.129 | True |
| D_feedback | 2.772 | 14.606 | -2.772 | True |

Ranking quality: the estimator's #1 candidate was also the best of its own top-8 (by simulation) on 12/30 workloads; D_feedback closes the rest of the gap.

## 7. Bank conflicts

Skewed mapping (implemented): zero extra cycles for every compute read and DMA write pattern (exhaustive test, tile dims up to 40, NB in {4,8,16}). Naive row-major layout of B serialises lane reads by gcd(tn, NB). Cycles with naive banking, for a schedule picked without knowing about conflicts vs one picked by the conflict-aware estimator:

| workload | skew_cycles | naive_oblivious | naive_conflict_aware | serial_cycles_oblivious | serial_cycles_aware |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gemm_sq64 | 38771 | 263161 | 40889 | 229376 | 0 |
| gemv_1x256x256 | 24675 | 66458 | 30609 | 57344 | 13568 |
| tall_512x16x64 | 67351 | 526103 | 143505 | 458752 | 0 |
| deepK_32x32x1024 | 141319 | 1050222 | 193597 | 917504 | 40960 |
| ragged_37x29x53 | 9818 | 9818 | 9818 | 0 | 0 |
| mlp_b32_L0 | 806151 | 6425863 | 834331 | 5619712 | 0 |
| conv3x3_16to32_28 | 474825 | 3615359 | 499995 | 3161088 | 28224 |
| attn_s64_d32_QKt | 19849 | 131819 | 19129 | 114688 | 0 |

Synthetic stride study (8 banks, strides 1..64): naive linear mapping conflicts for 32/64 strides (worst case 7 extra cycles); uniformly random 8-way access averages 1.55 extra cycles per access vector (unavoidable without a conflict-aware mapping).

## 8. Energy (Level 1 activity + Level 2 analytical only)

Level-2 values use ILLUSTRATIVE per-event energies (armse/energy.py) and are an analytical estimate, **not measured energy**; Level 3 (board measurement) was not performed. Geomean total-energy ratio across the suite, with a sensitivity sweep on the external-memory energy:

| dram_energy_scale | D_fb_vs_C_double | D_fb_vs_best_square |
|---|---|---|
| 0.500 | 0.909 | 1.156 |
| 1.000 | 0.898 | 1.187 |
| 2.000 | 0.891 | 1.208 |

## 9. Cost of the architecture (what is and is not measured)

On-chip data memory: 8192 B (65536 bits) - identical for all policies by construction. The unrolled descriptor programs are an extra cost of this implementation (128-bit entries); a simple repeat-with-delta compressor shrinks it only ~1.4x (results/PROGRAM_COMPRESSION.md) while streaming it from external memory costs ~1 % cycles (results/PROGRAM_STREAMING.md); neither is implemented in the RTL. Host-side scheduler time is Python wall clock (not a hardware cost).

| policy | program_bytes_mean | program_bytes_max | sched_ms_mean | sched_ms_max | buf_util_mean |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A_direct | 1216926.400 | 12591104 | 0.032 | 0.074 | 0.037 |
| B_fixed_single | 5608.000 | 28672 | 0.040 | 0.212 | 0.574 |
| C_best_square | 5762.133 | 28672 | 112.147 | 521.344 | 0.747 |
| C_fixed_double | 39181.333 | 212992 | 0.017 | 0.024 | 0.316 |
| D_adaptive | 11445.867 | 57344 | 369.312 | 986.283 | 0.576 |
| D_feedback | 11108.267 | 57344 | 399.539 | 974.649 | 0.593 |

Structural datapath size from the RTL source: NB 8x8 multipliers + adder tree, 2 skewed banked buffers (NB banks each), 1 output buffer (2 read ports), 2 descriptor sequencers, 1 burst DMA. **LUT / FF / DSP counts, timing closure and Fmax were NOT measured: no synthesis tool was available.**
